content.purpose: Delete selected files deliberately and verify the pattern first.
content.mentalModel: rm unlinks names immediately; it does not use a recycle bin. Permissions and open file handles may delay reclaimed storage, but the path is gone.

demonstration.explanation: This small example isolates the main idea behind removing files with rm.

remember: rm unlinks names immediately; it does not use a recycle bin. Permissions and open file handles may delay reclaimed storage, but the path is gone.

tasks.instruction: Remove only /home/student/lab/remove-me.txt. The neighbouring keep-me.txt must survive unchanged.
hints: Name the exact file rather than using a broad wildcard.
rm removes a file path; unlink is an equivalent single-file operation.
Check that the path ends in remove-me.txt before pressing Enter.
